content.text:
Here are some **free online auto repair estimate** options:

1. **RepairPal Estimator** — good for mechanical repairs like brakes, alternator, starter, A/C, oil leaks, etc. It gives fair price ranges by ZIP code and vehicle. ([repairpal.com](https://repairpal.com/estimator/repair-services?utm_source=openai))

2. **YourMechanic Instant Estimate** — free online quotes for many repair and maintenance jobs, with parts/labor breakdown and mobile-mechanic booking options. ([yourmechanic.com](https://www.yourmechanic.com/estimates/?utm_source=openai))

3. **Instant Estimator** — better for **auto body/collision damage**; you can get a free body repair estimate and upload photos for a more accurate quote. ([instantestimator.com](https://www.instantestimator.com/?utm_source=openai))

4. **VTCCO AI Estimate** — free online auto body estimate from uploaded accident/damage photos. Useful for a quick first-pass collision estimate. ([vtcco.com](https://vtcco.com/?utm_source=openai))

**Tip:** Use **RepairPal or YourMechanic** for mechanical repairs, and **Instant Estimator or VTCCO** for dents, bumpers, paint, and collision damage.

If you want, tell me your **year/make/model**, **ZIP code**, and what repair you need, and I can help you estimate the likely cost range.
